reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS units
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
RIGHT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'PlayBox'
GROUP BY p.product_id

solver.query:
SELECT p.product_id, COALESCE(SUM(sl.quantity), 0) AS units
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT l.product_id, l.quantity
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
) sl ON sl.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'PlayBox'
GROUP BY p.product_id
